retainers.name: Acolyte
retainers.summary: Light armor and one-handed weapon. Once per adventure after Blessing, cleric rolls d6+L; 7+ means Blessing is not spent. Must stand adjacent to assigned cleric.

retainers.name: Bodyguard
retainers.summary: 0-level warrior; any armor and weapons. +1 morale. May intercept any attack on assigned protectee. Reassign between rooms. Must stand adjacent to protectee.

retainers.name: Dungeon Guide
retainers.summary: Light armor and light weapon. Once per adventure reroll one room content, wandering monster, or search table.

retainers.name: Lantern Bearer
retainers.summary: Carries the party lantern; drops it if slain or flees. Light armor and one-handed weapon.

retainers.name: Man-At-Arms
retainers.summary: Only if the party has no warrior, barbarian, or dwarf. Any armor, shield, and weapon. +1 attack and +1 morale.

retainers.name: Minstrel
retainers.summary: Once per adventure, song removes 1 Madness from each party member. Light weapon only.

retainers.name: Porter
retainers.summary: Carries up to 400gp treasure or 2 bulky objects. −1 morale; drops cargo if he flees.

retainers.name: Rat Exterminator
retainers.summary: Vs rats: auto-kills d6 rats per attack and +2 Defense vs rats. Light armor and one-handed weapon.

retainers.name: Spear Carrier
retainers.summary: Carries assigned PC shield/weapon; owner can swap or ready shield without forfeiting an attack. Light armor; slashing hand weapon after handing gear back.

retainers.name: Surgeon
retainers.summary: Once per adventure heals 2 Life per character (beyond bandages). No armor; light weapon; can read scrolls.

alchemist_potions.name: Potion of Healing
alchemist_potions.summary: Restore all lost Life once per hero (standard potion rules).

alchemist_potions.name: Potion of Darksight
alchemist_potions.summary: Immune to −2 Attack/Defense when fighting without a lantern.

alchemist_potions.name: Potion of Vigor
alchemist_potions.summary: +1 saves vs poison or gas; immune to the Dark Plague.

alchemist_potions.name: Garlic Poultice
alchemist_potions.summary: Immune to vampire level drain for the adventure (apply before entering).

alchemist_potions.name: Powdered Silver
alchemist_potions.summary: +1 Defense vs werewolves for the adventure (apply before entering).

alchemist_potions.name: Elfblood Ointment
alchemist_potions.summary: Immune to ghoul/ghoul dragon paralysis (apply before entering).

alchemist_potions.name: Mindworth Extract
alchemist_potions.summary: +2 Defense vs mind screamers; +2 saves vs tentacled brains.

alchemist_potions.name: Elixir of Long Life
alchemist_potions.summary: If slain, d6+L 6+ avoids death and heals 1d6 Life once.

professionals.name: Alchemist
professionals.summary: Brew one potion (50gp + material cost). Ready when the party returns home (d6 vs difficulty).

professionals.name: Bladesmith
professionals.summary: +1 Attack in the first combat of the next adventure (main slashing weapon only).

professionals.name: Confessor
professionals.summary: Remove 1 Madness from one hero before the next adventure.

professionals.name: Fortune-Teller
professionals.summary: Roll 2d8 and bank one result for a reroll next adventure (barbarians forbidden; once per adventure).

professionals.name: Herbalist
professionals.summary: +1 saves vs poison and disease next adventure.

professionals.name: Sage
professionals.summary: First Clue spent next adventure counts as two.

professionals.name: Shieldmaker
professionals.summary: Reroll the first failed Defense roll when a shield applies next adventure.

professionals.name: Silversmith
professionals.summary: Silver-coat a slashing weapon (+1 vs lycanthropes) or 5 arrows before next adventure.

professionals.name: Storyteller
professionals.summary: +1 on the first retainer morale roll next adventure while patron lives.

professionals.name: Tailor
professionals.summary: Alter the first reaction roll ±1 if it would change a bribe outcome next adventure.
